creation.prompt:
Create exactly ONE Leo reusable character performance candidate on genuine transparent alpha. Reference 1 is the owner-reconciled v7 canonical and controls Leo identity, quadrupedal anatomy, honey/golden-cream felt body, tawny golden-brown curled mane and tail tuft, amber eyes, warm cream muzzle and rounded warm golden-cream paws. Reference 2 is an annotated derivative of that same canonical; its marks are measurement guidance only. Never draw colored lines, numbers, labels or backing. Use Leo's own proportions, never Milo's mouse head-fraction target. At compatible projection, visible mane/face width is about 1.99, near/far eye-to-face width about 0.24/0.15, muzzle/face about 0.60 and near fore/hind-paw-to-face spans about 0.66/0.55. These are uncertain projected observations, not new universal tolerance bands or recovered hidden anatomy. Preserve the canonical construction at the requested articulation rather than stretching separate parts. Full mane and ears, rounded soft toes, no sharp claws or grey nails, no extra limbs. Mouth closed. No visible speech-mouth or arbitrary teeth. Neutral soft studio light and genuine alpha, no background, scenery, tree, ground plane, contact shadow, Milo, prop, text, watermark or symbols. No character part cropped. This is a performance candidate, not an approved scene or scale anchor.

Requested depiction: Show the complete grounded sleeping lion lengthwise in a readable three-quarter side view: hindquarters/tail screen-left, head/nose screen-right, eyes closed, relaxed closed mouth and mane resting low. Preserve a natural quadrupedal body and distinct rear/front limbs. One visible REAR paw extends laterally toward an implied foreground path as the future trip obstacle; front paws rest naturally near the chest/head, distinct from that rear paw. Leave a physically readable flank-side travel corridor toward the nose when staged later; no path or mouse drawn. No raised or suspended body, no dog-like curled sitting pose. The later front-paw blocking action is not happening here.
